2. Introduce latency tracking state config and basic classes.

FLINK-13550.title: [FLINK-13550][rest][ui] Vertex Flame Graph
FLINK-13550.description:
## What is the purpose of the change

* Adds Flame Graphs to Flink in accordance to FLIP-165 [1].


## Brief change log

  - Adds a new REST handler to `WebMonitorEnpoint`
  - Adds a tracker as a results caching layer (`ThreadInfoOperatorTracker`)
  - Adds a coordinator for sampling `ThreadInfo` of parallel operator instances and assembling the results
  - Extends `TaskExecutor` method for sampling `ThreadInfo` for a particular `Task`
  - Adds `ThreadInfoSampleService` for repeated sampling of a specific `Task` 
  - Extends `JvmUtils` to enable data collection from a specific thread
  - Adds data structures for assembling and transferring the results (`ThredInfoSample`, `TaskThreadInfoResponse`, `OperatorThreadInfoStats`, `OperatorFlameGraph`)
  - Adds UI for displaying the sampling results

## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:
  - Added tests that validate that results are tracked (cached) correctly
  - Added tests that validate that samples from the parallel tasks are assembled correctly
  - Added tests sampling of individual threads is performed correctly

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): (yes, in the UI)
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: (no)
  - The serializers: (no)
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): (no)
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn/Mesos, ZooKeeper: (no)
  - The S3 file system connector: (no)

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? (yes)
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? (/ops/debugging/flame_graphs)
  

P.S: I would like to give kudos to @dmvk for his prototyping work [2] on this feature. Although the proposed implementation significantly diverges from his prototype on the Flink side, the work done on connecting the d3-flame-graph library to the right data structure retrieved from Flink was instrumental for enabling this feature.

---
[1] https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/FLINK/FLIP-165%3A+Operator%27s+Flame+Graphs
[2] https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/FLINK-13550?focusedCommentId=17083026&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-17083026
